VP Lin Shyue-Shyh bought $74,130 on 2026-07-21 and VP Tien Bor-Zen $73,060 on 2026-08-03. Most other officer amounts are small ($2,988-$5,287), so breadth carries this, not size. key_risks: The congressional leg is roughly six months old; disclosure bands ($1,001-15,000 for three of four filings) may overstate real conviction.
Most officer buys are $3,000-$5,000 and dated the same day (2026-07-07), which is consistent with a routine, non-discretionary pattern rather than independent decisions.
No option positions and no committee alignment fired for these buyers, so the sector-oversight angle is absent.
picks.invalidation: Officers stop buying or begin filing sales after 2026-08-03, or the members who bought in Jan-Feb file TSM sales, while price breaks below the 90-day low of 374.67.

picks.invalidation: Delaney files HUBB sales, the buying stops after 2026-07-23 with no other member joining, or price breaks below the 90-day low of 459.60.
